facts.claim: XPENG commissioned its humanoid-robot production line in Guangzhou on Sept 8, 2026; the first IRON finished assembly and "autonomously walked off the lines".
XPENG: over 80% of the line's core processes are automated ("core process automation exceeding 80%").
IRON specs: 76 degrees of freedom across the body, 21 in each hand; three Turing AI chips delivering up to 2,250 TOPS.

He Xiaopeng: "the robot production lines were created from scratch with no precedent to follow. Today's step is small, but XPENG is building the production lines for an entirely new product category."
XPENG robots "are scheduled to enter mass production by the end of this year"; official market launch and delivery in China and overseas planned for 2027.

XPENG's robotics business raised over US$900 million at a post-money valuation of over US$6.3 billion (Aug 24, 2026) - "the largest single-round private capital raise in China's embodied AI industry to date".
XPENG aims for more than 1,000 IRON robots per month by end-2026; IRON to serve as showroom sales assistants in China from Q1 2027.
"XPeng wants to be building more than 1,000 robots a month, on the way to a million a year by 2030." / "Tesla is still converting a car line. XPeng just turned one on."
"Musk once predicted Tesla would build roughly 10,000 Optimus robots in 2026"
Figure says BotQ went from 1 Figure 03 per day to 1 per hour - "a 24x throughput improvement in under 120 days" - after delivering over 350 robots.
Unitree CEO Wang Xingxing: Unitree plans to ship as many as 20,000 humanoid robots in 2026, up from about 5,500 in 2025.
At the Feb 16, 2026 Spring Festival Gala Unitree claimed: launched aerial flips over 3 m high, a 7.5-rotation Airflare spin, and cluster movement up to 4 m/s.
facts.source: Unitree press release (PR Newswire; company claims)

facts.claim: The 2026 gala broadcast averaged 325 million concurrent viewers and listeners per minute, peaking above 400 million (CMG figures).
One year earlier (2025 gala) Unitree's H1 robots performed a Yangko folk dance twirling handkerchiefs ("Yangge Bot").
Feb 23, 2026: 49 Unitree G1 robots performed synchronized martial arts at Beijing's Temple of Heaven; staff said there was no remote manual control - routines ran on pre-programmed instructions.
BGR: "it's hard not to imagine the show as a scene out of a sci-fi nightmare. It only takes one mistake to cause an injury."
Sept 7, 2026: Unitree claimed "The World's First Real-Time World Model-Driven Fully Autonomous Humanoid Robot Combat" using its UnifoLM-X2-1.0 model.
Feb 13, 2026: Unitree showed G1 humanoids assembling parts in its own robot factory, driven by its UnifoLM-X1-0 embodied AI model (footage at 2x speed).
Unitree listed on Shanghai's STAR Market (688836) on Aug 19, 2026 at ¥150.80/share (~¥61 billion valuation); shares opened up as much as 629% at ¥1,100.
Unitree 2025 revenue: 1.699 billion yuan; H1 2026 revenue 1.15 billion yuan (+48.54% y/y).
